flows.carries: idempotent startup: DB migration -> orphan cleanup -> TTS Server subprocess spawn+READY handshake -> plugin discovery -> task recovery
flows.invariant: boot_studio() is idempotent (global _booted flag); TTS server boot runs in a background thread so the web server isn't blocked; recovery runs only after reconciliation and listener registration so progress events reach the UI

flows.carries: chapter render request -> chunked/grouped text -> HTTP call into TTS Server subprocess -> plugin synthesis -> WAV written to chapter dir -> progress/ETA broadcast over WebSocket
flows.invariant: orchestrator never talks to the plugin directly; it always routes through VoiceBridge -> HTTP -> TTS Server subprocess, even for engines that are 'local' (XTTS)

flows.carries: one chapter split into groups by character/profile/engine; each group rendered through its own sub-engine via bridge; markers (START_SEGMENT/PROGRESS/SEGMENT_SAVED) drive weighted chapter-level progress across heterogeneous engine speeds; final stitch into one chapter WAV (this is the sequential path, still live at cap=1 or for non-segment-orchestrated callers; see parallel-segment-fanout for the concurrent path once a manifest raises max_concurrent_workers)
flows.invariant: INV-6: the orchestrator/worker_metrics owns performance-sample writing; the mixed handler itself never records calibration metrics to avoid poisoning ETA history

flows.carries: raw engine progress line -> velocity-ring sampling -> confidence-weighted ETA crossfade (calculated->observed) -> WebSocket frame -> frontend reducer with status-regression/progress-regression guards -> animated progress bar with its own client-side lane-migration smoothing
flows.invariant: confidence and ETA are never fabricated; frontend only trusts backend-computed confidence for §4A frames (chapters.progress/jobs.lifecycle) and only falls back to computeProgressConfidence() for older non-enriched frames (segments.progress/voice.test)

flows.carries: voice profile progresses samples -> build -> test -> ready (frontend/src/pages/Voices/voicePhase.ts state machine); build/test always finalize to MP3, never WAV
flows.invariant: voice samples and previews are MP3-only per the audio-format contract; WAV is deleted after successful MP3 conversion

flows.carries: character/voice assignment to a text span -> optimistic UI update -> revision-checked write -> stale audio invalidation on reassignment -> segments-updated broadcast
flows.invariant: base_revision_id excludes audio_status so a render completing in the background never causes a false 'modified by another process' conflict on an unrelated assignment edit

flows.carries: voice.json + variant profile.json + samples zipped for export (state.json/operational fields stripped); import validates against voice.schema.json, stages to a temp dir before atomic move, then re-syncs speaker DB rows from the resulting profile directories
flows.invariant: export/import always validates against the versioned voice.schema.json (spec_version); schema mismatches are hard failures, not silently coerced

flows.carries: REST snapshot on load/reconnect is merged with live WebSocket overlays; events arriving before the first snapshot are buffered (F3) and replayed once hydrated; only queue.items may create/rewrite rows, everything else overlays a fixed field allowlist; active_segments_map (W-PAR 006) rides the same queue.items frame as an additive overlay field
flows.invariant: reconnect prunes overlays older than (hydratedAtSeconds - 5s); the poll/refresh path does NOT prune (server timestamps may lag wall-clock) — asymmetric on purpose

path: app/orchestration/tasks/segment_synthesis.py#ChapterSynthesisTask.run (stitch barrier: futures.wait(ALL_COMPLETED) then sort by segment_order)
flows.carries: a chapter render for a segment-orchestrated engine fans its chunk groups into concurrent children (bounded by the per-engine-class semaphore); each child reuses _dispatch_segment's per-segment isolation via a synthetic one-group task rather than calling handle_mixed_job directly; completed children join at an explicit ALL_COMPLETED barrier and stitch in manuscript order regardless of completion order
flows.invariant: cap=1 (today's default) is byte-identical to the pre-fanout sequential SynthesisTask/handle_mixed_job path (INV-1); the chapter-fanout PARENT itself must never flow through _dispatch_segment (would register a spurious idle log_listener); a concurrent child must never call handle_mixed_job directly (would re-trigger chapter-terminal stitch/DB-rebuild once per child instead of once per chapter); synthetic fan-out children emit segment-scoped frames but no durable job rows (ephemeral TaskContext routes through ProgressService.publish(ephemeral=True), suppressing only jobs.lifecycle/queue.items/chapters.progress); chapter progress is size-weighted (grouped_progress from child text-length sums) and order-independent

invariants.rule: Importing a Studio 2.0 module must not start threads, register listeners, mutate global settings, or reconcile state — all such effects go through the explicit boot sequence in app/core/boot.py
Engine-specific logic lives behind the engine registry (app/engines/registry.py, behavior.py) + VoiceBridge; queue code, routes, and UI must not branch on engine IDs for core behavior

app/tts_server/** and plugins/*/plugin/server/** and plugins/*/plugin/studio/** must never import app.api, app.orchestration, app.db, app.domain, or app.jobs (enforced by AST validation in plugin_validation.py); only app.studio_plugin_sdk and app.engines.voice.sdk/base are allowed
app/orchestration/scheduler/orchestrator.py must not import app.jobs.worker, app.jobs.core, or app.db.queue directly — Studio 2.0 is a clean break from the legacy worker loop

Any path built from request data, DB values, uploads, or user-editable names is untrusted: use safe_join/secure_join_flat/find_secure_file (app/utils/pathing.py) — normalize+verify-under-root, never silently fix traversal attempts

Completion/reuse/recovery decisions use validated artifact metadata (manifests, DB rows cross-checked against disk), not raw file existence; segments marked 'done' with missing/invalid files are reset outside the DB lock (Rule 3)

Progress/ETA values are never fabricated: 0% is not special-cased as 'not started', confidence is derived from real velocity samples not defaulted to 1.0, and values are rounded to 2 decimals, broadcast only when advancing >=1%
Voice samples/previews are always MP3 (sample.mp3, samples/preview.mp3); chapter/book render audio is WAV; portable voice bundles are MP3

The queue.items WebSocket topic is the sole authority for queue row identity/creation/status; all other topics (chapters.progress, segments.progress, voice.test, jobs.lifecycle) may only overlay a fixed allowlist of fields (QUEUE_OVERLAY_FIELDS) on existing rows, never create rows or change status

Ownership split preserved: orchestrator owns job lifecycle, watchdog (app/engines/watchdog.py) owns TTS Server process lifecycle, VoiceBridge owns engine routing — these must not bleed into each other

Only PlayerBar (frontend/src/app/layout/PlayerBar.tsx) creates the <audio> element and drives playback; WaveformStrip and all other players bind to that element via playerBus, never create their own audio/AudioContext

Chapter script-view assignment writes carry a base_revision_id (hash excluding audio_status, to avoid false conflicts from render completion) and are rejected with 409/RevisionMismatch if the chapter changed concurrently
